extraction.name: Video-MME
extraction.description: A comprehensive multi-modal evaluation benchmark for MLLMs in video analysis, consisting of 900 videos across 6 visual domains and 2,700 manually annotated high-quality multiple-choice questions.
extraction.creator: Chaoyou Fu, Yuhan Dai, Yongdong Luo, Lei Li, Shuhuai Ren, Renrui Zhang, Zihan Wang, Chenyu Zhou, Yunhang Shen, Mengdan Zhang, Peixian Chen, Yanwei Li, Shaohui Lin, Sirui Zhao, Ke Li, Tong Xu, Xiawu Zheng, Enhong Chen, Caifeng Shan, Ran He, Xing Sun
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The data collection process involved three main steps: sourcing videos from YouTube across 6 domains and 30 categories, human annotation of multiple-choice QA pairs, and a quality review. Annotators created questions based on the videos, which were then peer-reviewed and filtered using Gemini 1.5 Pro to ensure they could not be answered using text alone.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw videos sourced from YouTube spanning 6 key domains and 30 fine-grained categories, with varying durations (short, medium, and long). The raw data also includes corresponding meta-information such as audio and subtitles (when available).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotators were tasked with watching entire videos and creating three multiple-choice questions (with four candidate options) per video. A rigorous manual review process was then conducted where a different annotator verified the clarity, answerability, and correctness of each QA pair.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: QA pairs underwent a manual review by a second annotator for clarity and correctness, followed by an automated validation step using Gemini 1.5 Pro to filter out questions that could be answered using text alone without the video context.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: 3 QA pairs per video, with each QA pair created by 1 annotator and reviewed by 1 different annotator.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Individuals with strong English proficiency and extensive research experience in vision-language learning.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Gemini 1.5 Pro was used as an automated filtering tool to remove QA pairs that did not strictly require video context.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluation of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs)
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Filtering out QA pairs that can be answered using only text without needing the video context.

name.evidence: In this paper, we introduce Video-MME , the first-ever full-spectrum, Multi-Modal Evaluation benchmark of MLLMs in Video analysis.

description.evidence: we meticulously curate a dataset of 900 videos across various scenarios, and annotate a set of 2,700 high-quality multiple-choice questions (3 per video) to foster a robust evaluation.
